title: NTE Host-Engine Capability Negotiation Specification
description: Defines runtime capability advertisement, statuses, and strict fallback policies between Native Host and Python Intelligence Engine.

capabilities.name: BitBlt
capabilities.description: Win32 GDI BitBlt frame capture baseline.
capabilities.notes: Proven production baseline with ~3.2ms median latency.

capabilities.name: WGC
capabilities.notes: Requires WinRT interop, manifest registration, and D3D11 staging texture readback. Not proven in production; must remain strictly NOT_MEASURED until isolated benchmark proves frame delivery.

capabilities.name: SharedMemoryRing
capabilities.description: Windows Named Shared Memory (MemoryMappedFile) 64-byte aligned ring buffer.
capabilities.notes: Zero-copy at process boundary mapping via numpy.frombuffer(mm, offset=64).

capabilities.name: NamedPipeIpc
capabilities.description: Windows Named Pipe control plane with 4-byte uint32 length prefix framing.
capabilities.notes: Supports fail-closed message parsing and 1 MB maxMessageBytes guard.

capabilities.name: LowLevelHooks
capabilities.description: Win32 WH_MOUSE_LL and WH_KEYBOARD_LL physical input monitoring on dedicated thread.
capabilities.notes: Explicit distinction: registryConfiguredLowLevelHooksTimeoutMs is 25000ms, but Windows 10 1709+ OS effectiveLowLevelHooksTimeoutMs is hard-capped at 1000ms. Synthetic microbench is 45us; real OS callback latency is NOT_MEASURED.

capabilities.name: WebView2
capabilities.description: Microsoft Edge WebView2 HTML/CSS/JS modern overlay presentation.
capabilities.notes: WebView2 environment initialization succeeded in spike, but CoreWebView2Controller Live Visual Tree hosting in Win32 HWND overlay is NOT automatic and remains EXPERIMENTAL.

capabilities.name: SendInput
capabilities.notes: Strictly prohibited and isolated from production. Unavailable in V2-0.

negotiationRules.scopeBoundary: Capability negotiation covers capability advertisement and fallback policy ONLY. Ring buffer geometry is NOT negotiated: slotCount, slotSizeBytes and mapTotalSizeBytes are fixed v1 constants derived from protocolVersion '1.0.0' (see message_catalog_v1.json -> ringBufferGeometry).
negotiationRules.hostAdvertisement: Host includes full dictionary of capabilities and statuses in HELLO message payload.
negotiationRules.engineAcceptance: Engine verifies all isMandatory capabilities are AVAILABLE. If any mandatory capability is UNAVAILABLE, Engine responds HELLO_ACK with status=REJECTED_CAPABILITY.
negotiationRules.unmeasuredPolicy: Any capability marked NOT_MEASURED (e.g. WGC) must NOT be activated by Engine; default fallback must be activated.
negotiationRules.experimentalPolicy: Any capability marked EXPERIMENTAL (e.g. WebView2) must be treated as non-authoritative projection only, with immediate fallback path to static native HUD.
